description: We are a multidisciplinary team of Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, and Artificial Intelligence students passionate about aerospace engineering, robotics, and emerging technologies. Our mission is to combine engineering expertise, AI, and software development to build an innovative, interactive astronaut mission simulator. We aim to create a technically ambitious, scientifically grounded project. We welcome creative problem-solvers with skills in programming, game design, and space science.
